baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins حَدِيثٍ to temporal بَعْدَهُ and asks which later discourse could receive يُؤْمِنُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A later report is placed in competition with the antecedent of the pronoun; faith is not bare notice but assent in which the heart can settle.

activation_trace.role: Speech arising as report supplies the candidate discourse under interrogation.
Afterness orders the candidate report beyond the pronominal antecedent.
Heart-settling confirmation makes belief the response whose possibility is denied.

changed_reading.before: Which statement will they accept next?
changed_reading.after: What later report could possibly secure trusting assent once the present discourse has failed to do so?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حَدِيثٍ can name an occurrence, calamity, or disclosure as well as speech, while بَعْدَهُ places any candidate beyond it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object of possible faith can be a happening that comes into being or reveals itself, so the question tests the sufficiency of witnessed event as well as verbal report.

activation_trace.role: Coming into being opens an eventive rather than exclusively verbal reading of حَدِيث.
A calamity of time supplies the severe eventive edge of the noun.
Disclosure makes an occurrence evidentiary rather than merely successive.
Temporal succession asks whether any still-later event remains available.
Settled security frames faith as entrusting oneself to what the event discloses.

changed_reading.before: The verse compares this text with some later speech.
changed_reading.after: The verse also asks what later occurrence or disclosure could establish trust after this one.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branches of حَدِيثٍ include fresh recentness and the polishing of a heart, directly beside the heart-settling branches of يُؤْمِنُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A new address can be imagined as another polishing stroke intended to clear a heart until it settles; بَعْدَهُ asks about the next attempted renewal.

activation_trace.role: Freshness supplies the possibility of a newly renewed address.
Polishing a heart gives renewed discourse a proposed transformative function.
Afterness supplies the imagined next attempt.
A settled heart is the intended result of the polishing.

changed_reading.before: The question asks only for a different proposition.
changed_reading.after: The question can ask what still-fresher intervention could polish an unsettled heart into trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening chain moves from dispatch through forceful spreading, differentiation, casting, reminder, and warning to the declaration that the promised matter will fall and stand. The final حَدِيث therefore gathers report, disclosure, and realized occurrence into one trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Report is the verbal starting state of the trajectory.
Coming into being is the realized state toward which the report moves.
Disclosure links announced content to manifested event.
Dispatch and setting-forth initiate the ordered transmission.
A force that carries things away turns transmission into effective motion.
Opening and spreading expands what was sent.
Distinguishing establishes consequential boundaries within the spread material.
Casting gives the reminder a concrete delivery action.
A reminder identifies the transmitted material as response-seeking address.
Warning supplies the address's prospective force.
A promise fixed to a time or place makes the report await realization.
Falling and becoming fixed closes the movement from announcement to occurrence.

structural_cues: 77:1-7 is a syntactically cumulative sequence whose final assertion names the promised matter as واقع.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered actions and the report/occurrence branches; I infer a directional passage from transmission to realization. A live alternative is that the opening agents and the promised event remain separate images rather than stages of one process.

changed_reading.before: No later piece of speech can outperform this piece of speech.
changed_reading.after: The discourse has already advanced from warning-report toward promised occurrence, so asking for a حَدِيث after it demands evidence beyond both announcement and realization.

context_deltas.mechanism: Erasure of luminous traces, opening of the sky, and uprooting of mountains convert the created order into a nonverbal disclosure. حَدِيث as disclosure is enacted by unmaking the ordinary signs through which the world was read.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the possibility that transformed creation itself communicates.
Occurrence lets the disclosure consist in events rather than propositions.
Erasing a trace removes the familiar celestial writing.
An opened breach makes what was closed newly disclosive.
Uprooting and removal overturn the apparent permanence of the mountains.

structural_cues: 77:8-10 presents three passive transformations of normally stable cosmic signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies erasure, opening, uprooting, and حَدِيث as disclosure; I infer that the transformed cosmos functions like an utterance. Alternatively, these may be only the narrated contents of the discourse.

changed_reading.before: حَدِيث is a report about future cosmic changes.
changed_reading.after: The cosmic changes are themselves a disclosure, leaving no supposedly clearer event after which trust could rationally be postponed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed term opens onto the severe day of separation; first peoples and later peoples are made consecutive and finally gathered. Against that total chronology, بَعْدَهُ is not an indefinitely open 'later' but an exposed horizon with no unaccounted audience or time beyond it.

activation_trace.role: Afterness supplies the temporal horizon that context progressively closes.
The ruin-edge of distance makes the closed horizon consequential rather than neutral.
Fixing a thing to a time gives the sequence a determined endpoint.
The day's severe event concentrates the endpoint into a decisive happening.
A prescribed limit prevents postponement from remaining indefinite.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood defines what the endpoint does.
The first peoples establish the opening edge of the human sequence.
Consecutive following links earlier and later peoples without a gap.
The later peoples establish the sequence's other human edge.
Gathering the dispersed closes the apparent temporal and social remainder.

structural_cues: 77:11-17 fixes a day and spans first to later peoples; 77:38 explicitly gathers the addressees with the first peoples.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed time, first/later succession, separation, and gathering; I infer that these jointly close the pragmatic horizon of 'after it.' The alternative is a simpler comparison with any later scripture or statement, without terminal force.

changed_reading.before: بَعْدَهُ merely means chronologically later than the antecedent.
changed_reading.after: بَعْدَهُ presses against a terminally complete sequence: what meaningful later time, audience, or adjudication remains in which another discourse could succeed?

context_deltas.mechanism: Weak generative fluid is created, held in a stable place to a measured limit, while earth gathers living and dead, mountains are fixed, and sweet water is supplied. These nested acts of origination, containment, measure, return, stability, and provision make embodied existence a material حَدِيث that has already come into being and disclosed itself.

activation_trace.role: Coming into being anchors the body-and-earth sequence in the focus noun.
Disclosure lets material history bear evidentiary force.
Trusting confirmation is the response solicited by the embodied evidence.
Creative origination supplies the first material coming-into-being.
Generative fluid places human embodiment inside the disclosed process.
Lowliness and weakness sharpen the contrast between origin and formed life.
Fixity and settling make containment productive rather than accidental.
A place of being gives the developing life a fitted location.
Measured limit gives the process proportion and completion.
Gathering into a receptacle extends womb-like containment to the earth.
Living creatures occupy one side of the earth's gathered contents.
Loss of life supplies return and termination within the same container.
Rooted stability gives the containing earth structural firmness.
Giving drink turns the containing environment into active provision.
Fresh sweetness identifies the provision as fitted to life.

structural_cues: 77:20-27 nests human gestation inside the earth's containment of living and dead, then adds stabilizing mountains and drinkable water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origination, containers, measure, life/death, stability, and water; I infer that their ordered material relation acts as testimony. A live alternative is that they remain examples asserted by the verbal حَدِيث rather than themselves becoming its eventive mode.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are asked to trust a verbal claim.
changed_reading.after: Their own emergence, maintenance, and return already enact the disclosure; the question asks what evidence after this embodied history could produce assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah traverses recognition by marks, recollection, knowing, speaking, and uttered address, yet ends with ء م ن. This lexical progression distinguishes availability of intelligible content from the heart's trusting confirmation of it.

activation_trace.role: Report supplies communicable content but not the response to it.
Heart-settling confirmation names the response that information alone does not guarantee.
Recognition after a mark opens the surah's epistemic sequence.
Recollection makes prior retention, not missing data, part of the response problem.
Explicit knowing marks the interrogated cognitive register.
Disclosure to a knower supplies determinate knowledge within the material sequence.
Speech is present as a capacity whose later removal does not erase prior address.
An uttered command makes the final informational opportunity explicit.

structural_cues: Epistemic and speech vocabulary appears from the opening oath through 77:48, immediately before the final question substitutes faith for those capacities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct branches for recognizing, remembering, knowing, speaking, uttering, and trusting assent; I infer that their sequence diagnoses a response gap rather than a data gap. Alternatively, the verbs may not form a deliberate epistemic scale.

changed_reading.before: Another clearer message might cure insufficient understanding.
changed_reading.after: The deficit is not intelligibility or available speech but the transition from recognition and knowledge to heart-settling assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated contradiction is followed by a day without speech, permission, or excuse; all parties are gathered and every stratagem is challenged. The final question consequently sounds like an adjudicative finding that no alternative account or defense remains viable.

activation_trace.role: Report supplies the alternative account whose remaining viability is tested.
Assent is framed as the response withheld after the case has been exhausted.
Excuse names the defense that the scene does not permit.
Contradiction of truth is the repeatedly recorded response culminating just before the question.
The loss of speech closes spontaneous counter-argument.
Withheld permission closes authorized defense as well.
Gathering all parties turns the address into a comprehensive hearing.
The open challenge to stratagem exhausts evasive alternatives.

structural_cues: The elevenfold refrain against deniers culminates at 77:49 after silence, barred excuse, gathering, and challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, silence, barred permission, assembly, and challenged stratagem; I infer a forensic progression from repeated refusal to exhausted defense. The alternative is purely homiletic repetition without courtroom force.

changed_reading.before: The question invites comparison with another persuasive statement.
changed_reading.after: The question pronounces the case closed: after denial has exhausted speech, excuse, and strategy, no rival account remains to receive their assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contrasts a nominal shade that neither shelters nor suffices against flame with protective shade, springs, pleasant intake, and recompense for action; it also contrasts enduring reward with brief enjoyment. In this field, ء م ن is entrusting oneself to a promised refuge and provision, not only agreeing with a proposition.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust anchor the refuge reading in the focus verb.
The report presents the competing shelter and provision claims to which one may entrust oneself.
Shelter and protection expose what the condemned shade promises but fails to provide.
Actual covering supplies the positive counterpart to failed shade.
Sufficiency names precisely what the false shade lacks.
Flame supplies the harm against which refuge is tested.
Active warding of harm defines the protected group.
Flowing springs make the secure refuge materially sustaining.
A provisioned share gives trust an experienced outcome.
Ease without harm contrasts reward with the failed protection.
Purposive action links entrusted commitment to consequence.
Recompense closes the causal relation between action and outcome.
Extended enjoyment supplies the benefit whose duration is then sharply limited.
Littleness contracts the condemned enjoyment against enduring provision.

structural_cues: 77:30-31 and 77:41-46 form opposed shelter-and-consumption scenes, with the latter pair of eat commands divided by outcome and duration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed and effective shelter, harm, provision, action, recompense, and short enjoyment; I infer that these materialize faith as reliance. An alternative keeps them as consequences of prior assent rather than part of the verb's activated force.

changed_reading.before: يُؤْمِنُونَ asks whether they deem the discourse true.
changed_reading.after: يُؤْمِنُونَ also asks which announced refuge and provision they will actually trust themselves to when counterfeit shelter is exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the final refrain and question, an uttered command meets bodies that do not bend. The context translates the gap between حَدِيث and ء م ن into the failure of heard speech to become humility and enacted assent.

activation_trace.role: Speech as report anchors the command within the focus noun's verbal range.
Trusting assent is the inward response whose enacted consequence is tested.
Audibly produced speech makes reception of the command unambiguous.
Bending and lowering the head gives assent a bodily form that is refused.

structural_cues: 77:48 states command and nonperformance in one mirrored construction; only the refrain at 77:49 separates it from the final question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies utterance, bending, refusal, and trusting assent; I infer that bodily compliance is the local diagnostic of faith. The alternative is that bowing is only one commanded act and should not define the full semantic range of ء م ن.

changed_reading.before: Faith is an inward judgment about the truth of a report.
changed_reading.after: The final question exposes a report that never reaches the body: what later speech will become trusting, humble action if this direct command did not?

context_deltas.mechanism: Reminder and warning are renewed after successive scenes, while the same denial-refrain returns eleven times. This repetition activates the fresh and polishing branches of حَدِيث but demonstrates that novelty, reiteration, and admonitory pressure have all failed to settle the heart.

activation_trace.role: Fresh recentness frames each renewed warning as another attempt rather than stale repetition.
Heart-polishing gives repeated admonition a cumulative transformative aim.
Settled security is the repeatedly unrealized result.
A reminder names the operation renewed across the surah.
Warning supplies the heart-awakening pressure of the repetitions.
The final repeated contradiction records that renewal has not altered the response.

structural_cues: The identical woe-refrain follows ten thematic blocks and occurs for the eleventh time immediately before 77:50.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, warning, repeated contradiction, freshness, and polishing; I infer that refrain recurrence functions as renewed pressure on the same heart. Alternatively, repetition may partition scenes without implying cumulative polishing.

changed_reading.before: A sufficiently novel later discourse might finally persuade them.
changed_reading.after: The surah has repeatedly renewed the warning, so the question denies that novelty or one more polishing repetition is the missing cause of faith.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because حَدِيث normally presents speech to the addressees, yet its explicit branch also names people becoming a tale. The destruction and succession of earlier and later peoples keep the reversal anchored; downstream prose should present it as an exemplary-tale activation, not as the verse's required syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حَدِيثٍ carries the branch 'becoming a tale people tell,' while بَعْدَهُ can place one exemplary history after another.

activation_trace.role: Becoming a tale reverses the audience from hearers of history into material for a later history.
Afterness orders exemplary peoples into a repeatable succession.
Destruction supplies the event by which a people passes into remembered history.
The first peoples supply the prior exemplary cohort.
Consecutive following makes the same fate structurally repeatable.
Later peoples include the present audience within the open succession.

changed_reading.before: The addressees merely decide whether to believe a tale.
changed_reading.after: By refusing the present tale, the addressees are positioned to become the next tale told after earlier peoples.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the construction بَعْدَهُ is straightforwardly temporal, but the focus inventory explicitly gives ruin and expulsion from good as a live edge of ب ع د, and the repeated woe plus destruction supplies contextual pressure. It should be rendered only as a secondary shadow on temporal 'after,' never as a replacement gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The temporal بَعْدَهُ also carries a branch of distance as ruin or curse beside يُؤْمِنُونَ as security and trust.

activation_trace.role: Distance as ruin or exclusion from good casts a punitive shadow over temporal afterness.
Security and trust supply the good from which continued refusal creates distance.
The last repeated contradiction supplies the act that sustains the distancing.
Destruction realizes the ruin-edge of distance within the surah.

changed_reading.after: The search for a discourse 'after it' can carry a secondary irony: postponement is itself movement farther from the security that faith names and toward ruin.

strongest_changes: The opening progression turns حَدِيث from report into the occurrence and disclosure it announces.
Fixed time, first/later succession, separation, and gathering make بَعْدَهُ press against a terminal horizon rather than an open-ended future.
Creation, gestation, earth, life/death, stability, and water make embodied material history function as evidence already disclosed.
The final adjacency of uttered command and refused bowing changes faith from informational assent alone into trust that reaches embodied action.
Repeated denial, silence, barred excuse, assembly, and challenged strategy make the question an adjudicative closure rather than a request for more information.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet let the three focus roots change domains without losing their anchors: حَدِيث moved among speech, event, disclosure, renewal, and exemplary tale; بَعْد moved from simple succession toward terminal and punitive distance; and ء م ن moved from confirmation toward security, reliance, and enacted humility.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent of the singular pronoun in بَعْدَهُ is not named inside the focus ayah, so context sharpens but does not grammatically force one referent.
The eventive and material-testimony readings of حَدِيث coexist with, rather than displace, the ordinary speech/report reading.
The refuge and embodied-action models may describe pragmatic consequences of faith more strongly than the focus verb's lexical content.
The heart-polishing and punitive-distance branches are deliberately retained as exploratory because their local syntactic fit is weaker.
